entities.summary: Sergio Casal Martínez is a former professional tennis player from Spain. During his career, he won three Grand Slam doubles titles, as well as the men's doubles silver medal at the 1988 Summer Olympics. Sergio Casal was a athletes & competitors from Barcelona (b. 1962-09-08, Barcelona). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
